text:
Situation: Penicillin G potassium has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2023-04-26 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 366 units of powder (24.3 days) and 162 units of injection (11.6 days). Corvale General holds 323 units of powder (20.6 days) and 248 units of injection (15.4 days).

Why (FDA record): The registered plant for the Roerig-labeled product is Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189). FDA inspection 1208260 at that plant ended 2023-06-16 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2024-09-10. The plant has a history of VAI classifications from inspections ending 2009-02-18 through 2023-06-16. Other firms on the FDA shortage list for related penicillin G products include Laboratorios Atral and Pfizer Inc., with Pfizer noting a manufacturing delay and estimated recovery in 4Q 2027.

Our position: Current inventory provides limited coverage across both campuses. No alternate supplier on our ranked list appears on the FDA shortage list today, but none of their labels identify a verifiable manufacturing plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to qualify Athenex Pharmaceutical Division, LLC as a purchase source; requires P&T Committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Avenacy Inc. as a purchase source; requires P&T Committee approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Chartwell RX, LLC as a purchase source; requires P&T Committee approval.
4. Buyer to qualify Laboratorios Atral, S.A. as a purchase source; requires P&T Committee approval.
5. Buyer to qualify NorthStar Rx, LLC as a purchase source; requires P&T Committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement decisions pending plant verification for alternate suppliers.
